notes: Component-local RC proof includes runtime gates, PHPUnit, PHPStan, coding-style checks, strict Composer validation, PHPUnit/Xdebug coverage generation, Playwright real-browser conversion-boundary proof, synchronized local PostgreSQL schema validation, and an HTTP 200 database-backed /currencing/demo proof.
Currencing has a stable Entity-first Symfony-oriented model, DTO/VO boundary, API contract, structural gates, and Exchanging boundary.
M19 adds a static console runtime proof gate for composer/bin/console/front-controller/config/template coherence before vendor-backed Symfony boot.
M20 fixes the first local Symfony boot blocker by adding symfony/var-exporter for Doctrine LazyGhost compatibility.
M21 closes the local database proof handoff after Symfony boot/routes/container/mapping passed and only PostgreSQL credentials remained unresolved.
M22 adds an explicit outbound template bridge contract for Bridge/Interfacing integration without coupling Currencing to UI implementation details.
